The '''Zabrak Tystel Mark III''', or '''Zabrak Tystel Mark 3''', was a powerful [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] model in use during the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the war, the Zabrak Tystel Mark III was sold on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] by members of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] a large number of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who were attempting to steal Mark III shipments. The weapons were still in use at some point after [[3662 BBY]], and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Corso Riggs]] was familiar with them by the time of the [[Galactic War]] fought between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Description==
The Zabrak Tystel Mark III,<ref name="kotor" /> also spelled Zabrak Tystel Mark 3,<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Heist of the Millennium|The King's Ransom}}</ref> was a type of [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] that was much more powerful and accurate than many of the more common heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistol designs of its [[Time/Legends|time]]. However, the weapon had an effective range of twenty-three [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="kotor" /> which was comparable to more common models.<ref name="kotorrange">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''&mdash;The ''Knights of the Old Republic'' instruction manual gives the range of a heavy blaster pistol as twenty-three meters.</ref> It fired [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Laser/Legends|energy bolts]], which caused brute-force damage to the blaster's target. The barrel of the Zabrak Tystel Mark III was gold in color, while the parts of the gun around the handle and trigger were metallic green. [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized [[Species/Legends|species]] could wield the [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] with one [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="kotor" /> The weapon could do considerable damage to an individual's face.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
Around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Tystel Mark III was used in various areas across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The weapon was sold by members of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] species, who [[Death/Legends|killed]] a number of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who attempted to steal shipments of the pistols. Not caring who bought the weapons as long as the sellers got paid, the Zabrak offered the Mark III on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="kotor" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="KotORDate" /> Mark IIIs sold for around 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each. One of the pistols found its way to the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Upper Shadowlands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where an [[Unidentified individual (Zabrak Tystel Mark III owner)|individual]] who possessed the weapon had died, leaving it on the corpse. During the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], another of the pistols was located in a [[Black Rakatan Settlement|settlement]] headed by a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] known as [[the One]] on the planet<ref name="kotor" /> [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="Lehon" /> The weapons were still used in the galaxy<ref name="TOR" /> at some point after [[3662 BBY]].<ref name="Corso">The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' establishes [[3662 BBY]] as the birth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Corso Riggs]]. As he was familiar with the capabilities of the weapon, he must have seen or heard about one at some point in his life.</ref> By the start of the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> [[Corso Riggs]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] partner of a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] working for the Republic, was familiar with the weapon and its capabilities.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Are you really willing to gamble that I don't have at least one man who could blow your brains to jelly in a single shot?''"<br />"''You ever seen what a Zabrak Tystel Mark 3 does to a man's face?|The smuggler captain and Corso Riggs threatening Lieutenant Palinx onboard the ''King's Ransom''|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The Zabrak Tystel Mark III first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, it was only found on a corpse in the Upper Shadowlands of the planet Kashyyyk and in a footlocker located in the One's Rakatan settlement on the Unknown World. Compared to the generic heavy blaster pistol from the game, the weapon had an increased attack bonus and had a small increase to its energy damage value, as well as a physical-damage bonus. The game does not specify whether or not the Zabrak designed the Mark III; it only states that they were selling it.<ref name="kotor" />

In [[2011]], the weapon was mentioned again in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a MMORPG produced by BioWare that was a sequel to ''Knights of the Old Republic''. In the game, the weapon's name was spelled "Zabrak Tystel Mark 3" and could be mentioned in "Heist of the Millennium", a quest for players of the smuggler class. The weapon is only mentioned if the player has Corso Riggs in their party and chooses the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] path of a conversation with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Palinx]], an Imperial who attempts to stop the player while they sneak aboard the Imperial [[Treasure ship|treasury starship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']]. With any other companion or alignment choice, the Zabrak Tystel Mark 3 will not be mentioned, and it is not mentioned in any other conversation in the game.<ref name="TOR" />
